study_design: Prospective UK Biobank cohort analysis using repeated 24-hour dietary assessments and Cox regression
reason: The prospective analysis reports incident prostate cancer generally. The abstract does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal prostate cancer endpoint. The prostate-specific analytic number of men is not stated in the abstract.
